name: io.github.sepehr071/iran-weather-mcp
title: Iran Weather
description: Read-only Iran Meteorological Org (irimo.ir): city forecasts, observations, warnings.

environmentVariables.name: IRAN_WEATHER_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: HTTP proxy URL for irimo.ir, which answers only Iranian IPs (set an Iranian proxy when running abroad); system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
